dish: Estate wines and Wollersheim's own brandy, tasted in the 1840s-rooted stone cellars
address: Across the Wisconsin River east of Prairie du Sac, Dane County, WI
w: Wisconsin's historic winery: Hungarian count Agoston Haraszthy planted these slopes in the 1840s before leaving to found California's wine industry; Peter Kehl's stone buildings are on the National Register. Now a winery, distillery and restaurant.
